items.title: Clay Jenkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 18, 2016
items.q: And he played with all these great drummers like Sonny Payne and Jo Jones and Mel Lewis and Jeff Hamilton and Ed Shaughnessy and all these great drummers.

ctx.x: How about playing the time? Was that different?

Well on Basie’s band yeah, it was definitely different. But playing the time in terms of the lead trumpet player connecting with the drummer, Snooky was the prince of that. And he was so amazing with that. And he played with all these great drummers like Sonny Payne and Jo Jones and Mel Lewis and Jeff Hamilton and Ed Shaughnessy and all these great drummers. And he played lead. And that just made the band — that connection between lead trumpet and drums was unbelievable. And he’d come right out and say, “that’s…
I have this wonderful moment with him talking with Gerald Wilson and they were talking about going from the Lunceford band —
